content.short: Redstone Oracle provides real-time, reliable data feeds for DeFi applications operating on the TON blockchain.
content.description: Redstone is a modular oracle protocol that delivers high-frequency, reliable data feeds for decentralized finance (DeFi) on the TON blockchain. It utilizes an innovative data delivery model that bypasses traditional on-chain storage costs by delivering signed data packages off-chain and allowing dApps to verify them on-demand. Redstone supports thousands of assets, including cryptocurrencies, stocks, and commodities, providing TON developers with the precise and timely information needed to build sophisticated lending protocols, DEXs, and synthetic asset platforms.
content.meta: Power your TON DeFi dApps with Redstone's reliable data oracles. Discover more tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
